items.stem: What is the mean of the following set of numbers: 4, 7, 10, 13?
A student scored the following points on four math quizzes: 85, 90, 78, and 87. What is the mean score for the student’s quizzes?
Which of the following statements about the mean are true? Select ALL that apply.
choices: The mean can be affected by extremely high or low values in the data set.
The mean is the middle number when all the values are arranged in order.
The mean represents a balance point of the data set.
The mean is found by adding all values and dividing by how many values there are.

items.stem: The following numbers represent the number of books read by five students during summer: 3, 7, 5, 9, and 6. Find the mean number of books read. Show or explain your work.
